info.name: Blockwise
info.summary: Plan your commitments in the calendar, work through tasks block by block, and see where your time goes.
Pianifica i tuoi impegni nel calendario, lavora ai task blocco per blocco e scopri dove va il tuo tempo.
info.description:
Each commitment (e.g. Thesis, Work) is a Nextcloud calendar. Italian: impegno. Every event in that calendar is a work block.
* Ordered task queue per commitment, with checkable subtasks; unfinished work carries over to the next block * Notes per commitment in Markdown, with checklists; ticked notes show in Done * Play button to track time, optional Pomodoro mode, reminder before a block ends * Warning when blocks of different commitments overlap * Charts of what you did and how long you spent, per day, week and month * Export and import everything, encrypted with a passphrase if you like
info.author: amecs-gh
